title: Omnisend: legacy Pro SMS credits end today
body: Omnisend's help center says legacy Pro accounts keep SMS credits equal to their plan price until 26 October 2026. Since 4 May 2026, new Pro accounts buy SMS separately, and the Standard plan has no SMS. Stores relying on included SMS should check their next invoice.

title: Tracking starts
body: First reading of 11 apps and their plans. From here, each listing is re-read and every change is dated in this log.
